name: lead-scorer
description: Lead Scorer: o sistema que qualifica os deals do pipeline (AI Master Challenge 003)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @lead-scorer/api" "npm run dev -w @lead-scorer/web"
scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run start -w @lead-scorer/api
scripts.test: npm run checar && npm run test:unit && npm run test:dados
scripts.checar: node scripts/checar-fronteiras.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
